review_candidates.title: Integration Manager & Technical Support Specialist
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Integration Manager & Technical Support Specialist based in United Arab Emirates. This is a hands-on technical support and integration role focused on ensuring merchants are fully configured, technically validated, and ready for successful production launches. You will work at the intersection of merchant onboarding, payment integrations, troubleshooting, and platform reliability within a fast-moving fintech and crypto environment. The role involves configuring payment methods and routing, validating APIs, investigating transaction issues, and identifying the root causes of technical incidents. You will collaborate closely with international merchants and Engineering teams to resolve complex issues and ensure smooth Go-Live experiences. With significant ownership over production readiness, your work will directly contribute to platform reliability and merchant success. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically curious support professional who enjoys solving challenging problems and working with modern financial infrastructure. Accountabilities Lead technical merchant onboarding by configuring integrations, payment routing, and payment methods across PSP, on/off-ramp, and card solutions. Manage API access and system environments, including issuing API keys and ensuring configurations are correctly established for production readiness. Validate API requests and troubleshoot integration issues using tools such as Postman, identifying configuration or technical problems before merchants go live. Investigate transaction incidents by analyzing JSON payloads, SQL queries, system logs, and monitoring data to identify root causes and determine appropriate remediation. Use monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana to trace transaction errors and investigate issues across technical systems. Replicate and isolate reported bugs to determine whether an issue originates on the merchant side or within the platform. Triage technical issues and provide clear, actionable escalations to Engineering when deeper investigation or product fixes are required. Support the final technical verification and production readiness process for merchants, ensuring configurations and integrations meet the required standards before launch. Communicate technical findings clearly to international merchants and internal stakeholders, translating complex technical issues into understandable explanations and actionable next steps. Prepare concise incident reports and technical findings while maintaining accurate documentation throughout troubleshooting and resolution processes. Remain accountable for issues through resolution, prioritizing accuracy, responsiveness, and reliable execution in time-sensitive situations. Requirements You have at least 1 year of experience in L2/L3 technical support or a strong track record as a Senior Support Agent or Support Manager, ideally within fintech, crypto, payments, or a related technology environment. You have hands-on experience working with system logs and monitoring tools and can trace transaction errors to identify their underlying causes. You understand client-server architecture, REST APIs, and JSON structures and can apply this knowledge to integration troubleshooting. You are comfortable using Postman to validate API requests, investigate responses, and troubleshoot integration issues. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform root-cause analysis and develop clear remediation plans under time constraints. You have exceptional attention to detail and understand the importance of precision when managing technical configurations, access credentials, payment settings, and production environments. You are proactive and self-directed, taking ownership of merchant issues rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions. You can quickly learn new technical documentation, systems, workflows, and product requirements in a rapidly evolving environment. You remain calm and effective under pressure and are comfortable handling incidents where accuracy and response time are critical. You have fluent Russian language skills and upper-intermediate to advanced English proficiency, approximately B2/C1, enabling you to communicate complex technical matters effectively with international merchants and colleagues. You can write concise incident reports and present technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are committed to continuous learning and are motivated by opportunities to develop toward senior SRE, product, or engineering responsibilities. Benefits Fully remote work within an agile and international team. Competitive salary based on your experience, skills, and individual contribution, with salary expectations requested in USDC. Career progression opportunities toward senior SRE, product, or engineering roles. Significant ownership and direct impact on platform reliability, merchant success, and production readiness. Opportunity to work at the intersection of fintech, cryptocurrency, payments, APIs, and digital financial infrastructure. Collaborative and transparent working environment that encourages open communication, experimentation, and measurable impact. Opportunity to work on technically challenging problems while continuously developing your technical and analytical skills. La amplia experiencia de MSXI en el sector, combinada con un avanzado análisis de datos y soluciones de software personalizadas, mejoran el rendimiento de las redes de concesionarios de automoción aumentando los ingresos, reduciendo los costos y mejorando la satisfacción del cliente. Descripción del empleo El objetivo principal de nuestr@ futur@ Formador /a es asegurar que el personal técnico de nuestro cliente tenga toda la información, habilidades y conocimientos necesarios para desarrollar de forma profesional sus funciones en el diagnóstico y reparación de los vehículos. (Por la naturaleza del puesto, la posición se desempeña de manera presencial) Tus responsabilidades Diseñar, desarrollar e impartir formación técnica dirigida a la red de talleres, tanto en formato presencial, online como en streaming, garantizando una experiencia formativa dinámica y de alto impacto. Crear materiales didácticos adaptados a las necesidades de los participantes: guías, manuales, ejercicios prácticos, presentaciones y otros recursos que faciliten la comprensión y aplicación de los conceptos técnicos. Revisar, actualizar y adaptar los contenidos formativos con base en las últimas novedades del mercado y en la información técnica proporcionada por el cliente, asegurando que la formación esté siempre al día. Participar en sesiones de entrenamiento, tanto a nivel nacional como internacional, para garantizar una transmisión homogénea y actualizada del conocimiento. Colaborar en la planificación y logística de las acciones formativas: programación de convocatorias, coordinación de recursos, gestión de espacios y soporte operativo para el correcto desarrollo de los cursos. Diseñar y elaborar cuestionarios de evaluación (pre y post formación) que permitan medir el progreso y el nivel de adquisición de conocimientos de los participantes. Analizar los resultados de la formación y los niveles de satisfacción, elaborando informes de seguimiento, identificando oportunidades de mejora y destacando buenas prácticas que contribuyan a la excelencia del programa formativo. Requisitos ¿Qué buscamos en ti? Estudios de Grado Medio en Electromecánica, Grado Superior en Automoción, Ingeniería o titulaciones afines. A partir de 3 años de experiencia en formación, idealmente en el ámbito técnico. Experiencia previa como mecánico, técnico de diagnosis, formador técnico o delegado de asistencia técnica, con amplio dominio en electricidad del automóvil, mecánica, gestión del vehículo e infotainment u otros sistemas avanzados. Vocación por la enseñanza y gusto por compartir conocimiento. Deseable experiencia con herramientas para el desarrollo y gestión de formación: Office 365, Canva, Prezi, Paquete Adobe, LMS, Aplicaciones móviles de dinamización, Pizarras digitales. Idiomas Nivel de inglés intermedio. (B2) Portugués deseable. Soft Skills Excelentes habilidades comunicativas y capacidad para transmitir conceptos técnicos. Capacidad de análisis, síntesis y organización. Enfoque innovador y valoración de la autonomía en el trabajo. Capacidad para trabajar de forma colaborativa y sentirse cómodo en equipo. Información adicional Con Más De 5,000 Empleados Ubicados En Más De 80 Países Alrededor Del Mundo, Nuestros Equipos Brindan Una Experiencia Líder En La Industria Que Abarca Compromiso del Consumidor Rendimiento de Piezas, Accesorios y Servicio Información Procesable Optimización y Cumplimiento de Reparaciones Soluciones de Aprendizaje Rendimiento de Distribución y Ventas Nuestra trayectoria probada significa que ahora colaboramos con casi todos los fabricantes de automóviles en el mercado. El Propósito de MSX Empoderar a quienes impulsan y crean para que prosperen en nuestro mundo en constante cambio. La Misión de MSX Aprovechar nuestra experiencia en movilidad, la creatividad de nuestros equipos globales y el poder de la tecnología para crear soluciones personalizadas, sostenibles e innovadoras. La Visión de MSX Ser la primera opción de los clientes, reconocidos por nuestra excelencia operativa y nuestro compromiso con impulsar el cambio y la innovación en la industria de la movilidad. MSX es un empleador que promueve la igualdad de oportunidades y alienta positivamente las solicitudes de candidatos debidamente cualificados y elegibles, independientemente de su sexo, raza, discapacidad, edad, orientación sexual, cambio de sexo, religión o creencias, estado civil, embarazo o maternidad. Como usuarios del programa de confianza en la discapacidad, garantizamos entrevistar a todos los candidatos discapacitados que cumplan los criterios mínimos para la vacante.

review_candidates.description: Req ID: 386803 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now. We are currently seeking a Z2_Open Text Cloud Developer to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN). Job Description – Expert OpenText Cloud Consultant Role: Expert OpenText Cloud Consultant – Content Server, Archive Center, Intelligent Viewing, Directory Services & Information Archive, with Kubernetes & Helm Positions: 1 Role Summary The Expert OpenText Cloud Consultant leads the cloud and containerized delivery of the OpenText platform. The role designs and implements enterprise-grade deployments of Content Server, Archive Center, Intelligent Viewing, Directory Services and Cloud Information Archive on OpenText Cloud (CSP) and Kubernetes, including Helm-based packaging, CI/CD, observability, resilience and operational readiness. Key Responsibilities Design and implement OpenText Cloud (CSP) deployments of Content Server, Archive Center, Intelligent Viewing and Directory Services, including tenant setup, environment topology and hybrid connectivity to on-premises systems. Design and implement Cloud Information Archive: ingestion pipelines, indexing, search, retention policies, legal hold and compliance/eDiscovery capabilities. Build, maintain and version Helm charts and Kubernetes manifests for the in-scope products: configuration management, secrets via a managed secrets store, resource requests/limits, liveness/readiness probes, autoscaling, affinity rules and rolling upgrade strategies. Implement enterprise-grade Kubernetes practices: namespace and RBAC design, network policies, pod security standards, non-root containers, pinned and scanned images, and image supply-chain hygiene. Implement CI/CD pipelines for image build, chart packaging, environment promotion and automated rollback. Implement observability: centralized logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, SLOs and alerting for containerized OpenText workloads. Design and validate resilience: high availability, multi-zone deployment, backup and restore, disaster-recovery runbooks and periodic failover testing. Own cloud cutover planning and execution: migration of workloads from on-premises to cloud, dry runs, rollback plans and hypercare. Perform performance and capacity engineering: sizing, load testing, tuning of application, storage and database layers; cloud cost optimization. Ensure security and compliance of cloud deployments: TLS everywhere, encryption at rest, key and certificate management, least-privilege identities, audit logging, vulnerability scanning and patching. Act as expert advisor on OpenText Cloud roadmap, service limits, upgrade cycles and vendor coordination. Produce operational runbooks, as-built documentation and deliver knowledge transfer to internal operations teams. Service mesh, API gateway and ingress controller configuration. Database operations for ECM workloads (SQL Server/PostgreSQL) including HA and backup strategies. Cost management and FinOps practices for cloud workloads. Large-scale archive migration to cloud archiving platforms. Cloud/CSP deployment architecture and environment topology documentation. Production-grade Helm charts, Kubernetes manifests and per-environment configuration. CI/CD pipeline definitions for build, deploy and rollback. Observability setup: dashboards, alerts and SLO definitions. Backup/restore and disaster-recovery design plus tested runbooks. Cloud Information Archive configuration and compliance/retention setup. Cutover, rollback and hypercare plans; post-go-live reports. Operational runbooks, as-built documentation and knowledge transfer. Required Skills Deployment and operation of OpenText Content Server, Archive Center, Intelligent Viewing, Directory Services, and Information Archive in cloud and/or containerized environments. OpenText Cloud (CSP) service model: tenant onboarding, environment management, connectivity and vendor interaction. OpenText Information Archive / Cloud Information Archive: ingestion, retention, search, compliance and eDiscovery configuration. Strong Kubernetes skills: workloads, services, ingress, storage classes and persistent volumes, ConfigMaps/Secrets, RBAC, network policies, autoscaling, troubleshooting. Strong Helm skills: authoring and maintaining production-grade charts, templating, values management per environment, chart versioning and release management. CI/CD tooling and GitOps-style deployment workflows. Observability tooling: logging, metrics, tracing and alerting stacks. Cloud networking and security: TLS/mTLS, certificate lifecycle, secrets management, identity and access management, hardening standards. Backup, restore and disaster recovery design and testing for stateful enterprise workloads. Relevant certifications in Kubernetes or a major cloud platform. Soft Skills Expert-level autonomy in complex cloud and hybrid environments. Strong troubleshooting across application, container, network and storage layers. Pragmatic risk awareness with a strong operational and security mindset. Effective collaboration with architecture, development, infrastructure and vendor teams. review_candidates.description: Executive Assistant — Private Wealth & Investment Office Be the trusted operations hub for a dynamic private investment portfolio. Are you an exceptionally organized professional with diplomatic acumen, discretion, and a knack for seamless orchestration? Do you thrive in fast-paced, high-touch environments where your impact shapes how executives lead? Join a sophisticated private investment office supporting senior leadership across wealth management, corporate governance, and family office operations. Your Challenge You will be the operational cornerstone for a complex, multi-faceted role—managing executive calendars, coordinating international travel, safeguarding sensitive correspondence, and orchestrating everything from board meetings to personal affairs. This is not administrative work; it's strategic operations at the highest level. You'll navigate competing priorities, interact with internal teams across multiple entities, external advisors, and service providers, all while maintaining confidentiality and flawless execution. Your ability to anticipate needs, solve problems independently, and build trusted relationships with stakeholders will directly influence business continuity and executive effectiveness. What You'll Do Calendar & Meeting Management: Organize, prioritize, and optimize internal and external meetings, coordinate across diverse teams and group entities, track action items, and ensure seamless executive availability. Travel Coordination: Plan and execute complex travel itineraries across Europe and beyond, including air, rail, and accommodation bookings, logistics coordination, and contingency management. Stakeholder Communications: Conduct professional correspondence, manage telephone interactions, and draft communications with internal teams and external partners in French and English. Investment & Board Support: Prepare dossiers for investment mandates, organize preparatory and ad-hoc meetings, and manage documentation for governance and decision-making. Events & Hospitality: Oversee executive dinners, manage invitations, coordinate catering, arrange protocol-appropriate hospitality, and welcome high-level visitors. Personal Office Operations: Manage expense tracking (corporate cards, SNCB, transportation), invoice verification, vendor payments, and liaison with financial advisors. Personal Affairs Management: Oversee personal and family expenses, coordinate insurance and property matters, schedule medical appointments, manage memberships and professional networks, and handle occasion-based communications (gifts, greeting cards). Logistics & Facilities: Coordinate office logistics, equipment management (IT systems, mobile devices), liaise with office management for facilities, and ensure seamless daily operations. Driver & Transportation Coordination: Plan and manage executive transportation, coordinate with drivers, and organize logistics for movement. Records & Archives: Maintain organized, confidential archival systems for business and personal documentation. Ad-hoc Support: Respond flexibly to evolving priorities and emerging needs with proactive solutions. What You Bring Demonstrated experience as an executive assistant, office manager, or in a similar high-touch, confidential support role—preferably within a C-suite, family office, or investment environment. Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple competing priorities without compromising quality. Fluency in French and professional English; additional languages (Dutch, German) a plus. Diplomatic discretion and ability to maintain absolute confidentiality with sensitive personal and business matters. Proficiency with calendar management systems, CRM platforms, Microsoft Office, and travel/expense management tools. Strong interpersonal skills: ability to interact professionally with executives, advisors, external service providers, and team members at all levels. Proactive problem-solving mindset and comfort working independently with minimal supervision. Willingness to adapt to dynamic, sometimes unpredictable demands and travel requirements as needed. Valid driver's license (bonus). Discretion, judgment, and ability to anticipate needs before they are expressed. What You Can Expect A uniquely influential role at the intersection of operations, governance, and executive leadership. Competitive compensation reflecting the seniority and sensitivity of the position. Flexible working arrangements and understanding of the demands of executive support. Professional development opportunities and exposure to high-level business and investment operations. A collaborative, respectful culture where your contributions are recognized as indispensable to organizational success. The opportunity to work alongside accomplished executives and build lasting professional relationships. Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, meal vouchers, and leave arrangements aligned with local practice. A stable, internationally respected organization where excellence is valued and discretion is paramount. If you are a detail-oriented, diplomatically skilled professional who takes pride in seamless execution and can thrive in a confidential, high-stakes environment, we would like to hear from you. Apply today and discover how you can become an essential partner to executive leadership.
